description: A raster visual intended to be composed into a user interface by a frontend agent or designer.

hero: Create a website hero visual with clean copy space on the left.
section-illustration: Create a compact crop-safe illustration for a product section.
rectangular-background: Create a wide background asset for a desktop application header.
decorative-texture: Create a restrained decorative texture without promising seamless tiling.

prompt_guidance: State target dimensions, layout-safe regions, crop tolerance, palette, and the surrounding interface context.
prohibited_content: Do not bake controls or interface labels into the image.
Do not present generated icons as production-ready assets.
Do not promise transparent output or seamless tiling.

dimensions.description: The asset matches the requested pixel dimensions.

aspect_ratio.description: The asset matches the requested interface ratio.

crop_tolerance.description: The composition remains usable under the intended crop.

palette_compatibility.description: The palette works with the stated interface colors.

style_system_consistency.description: The asset fits the surrounding visual system.

layout_composability.description: The asset leaves usable space for interface composition.

edge_quality.description: Important subjects and details remain clear at asset edges.
